name: Cinematic Illustrated Psychology World v1

character.head: large simple round or slightly oval head
character.face: minimal expressive eyes, optional eyebrows, small mouth
character.limbs: very slim simplified illustrated limbs with slight width
character.hands: simple stylized hands, no realistic finger anatomy

characterPresence.rule: use humans only when human action/reaction is the clearest explanation

hardFails: bare line stickman or whiteboard doodle
supporting/background human from a different character family
mixed anatomy families inside one crowd
unnecessary decorative human when a no-human visual is clearer
globalPrompt: Create a cinematic 2D illustrated frame for a modern psychology YouTube channel. Keep one consistent film-world. Every visible human — main, supporting and background — must use the same stylized stickman-inspired anatomy family with large simple round heads, minimal expressive faces, compact clothed torsos, very slim simplified limbs, simple hands and shoes. Individualize only through clothing, simple hair/accessories, size, posture and expression. Never mix in normal cartoon humans, realistic people or another character family. Human presence is optional: when a person is not needed, use schemas, objects, metaphors, comparisons, environment illustrations or text illustrations in the same linework, color, soft cel shading, depth and lighting language. Use colorful believable environments, cinematic framing and small meaningful details. No photorealism, no 3D/Pixar, no anime, no corporate vector look, no whiteboard doodle style.
